about:
![Postbox: the mailbox Azeroth deserves. Its window collects all its mail in one click while it changes look: the Postbox style, the game's own look on Retail and on Forever, ElvUI and EllesmereUI. Then a search takes only the ore, and one item is taken from a mail without opening it. For Retail and Forever, each beside its game's own emblem, with the Blizzard UI, ElvUI or EllesmereUI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/egsherlock/Postbox/main/docs/screenshots/hero.gif)

  **A modern, lightweight replacement for the World of Warcraft mailbox.**

  Collect everything or just what sold, keep track of every character's mail and what's about to expire, send with names that finish themselves, and shape the window to fit your UI.

  **Runs on retail WoW (12.0.7–12.1.x) and, since 1.60, World of Warcraft: Forever (1.60.1), from one download.**

  On the Blizzard UI it wears the game's own look or its own Dark or Light style; under ElvUI or EllesmereUI it matches them.

  No dependencies, no libraries  · 
  [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/postboxmail)  · 
  [Changelog](https://github.com/egsherlock/Postbox/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)  · 
  [Report a bug](https://github.com/egsherlock/Postbox/issues)

## At a glance

| | |
|---|---|
| **Mail tab** | One-click collection in the order your list shows, search, sort and filter, row selection, buttons by kind (three on by default) and for your own character groups, finished mail under one quiet bar, and a History of what you collected and sent. |
| **Arrange** | Drag, hide and set up every column and button right in the window; each list keeps its own layout. |
| **Mail Memory** | Every character's last-seen mailbox, from anywhere, searchable across characters, with warnings before mail is lost. |
| **Send tab** | Names complete as you type, a line says what a send will do, gold always asks first, and more than twelve items go out in one press. |
| **Minimap icon** | Optional: two dozen hand-painted styles, a count of what's waiting, and a marker for mail about to expire. |
| **Looks** | Follows EllesmereUI or ElvUI; on the game's own UI, wears the Blizzard look (the default: the game's frames, buttons and letter paper) or the Postbox style in Dark or Light. |
| **Options** | Five tabs, General first with every character's mail and your last 7 days at a glance, a search that finds any setting, and a panel that explains and previews whatever you point at. |
| **WoW Forever** | The same download: full names, Forever's mail rules, slow sends waited for, and Blizzard's mailbox for controller players. |

Found a bug, on retail or in WoW Forever? Please report it: open an
[issue](https://github.com/egsherlock/Postbox/issues) or leave a comment on
[CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/postboxmail). **Report a
bug**, at the foot of the options (or `/postbox debug`), gives you a report
to paste in, with no character names in it.

## World of Warcraft: Forever

Since 1.60 the same download runs in WoW Forever: CurseForge lists it under
WoW Forever, and WowUp offers it for a Forever install. By hand, copy the
`Postbox` folder into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`.
Forever keeps its own settings, separate from retail's.

- **Full names.** Write the whole name, "Abla Stone" or "Abla-Stone" (the
  same character either way). Postbox uses the full name everywhere, so two
  of your characters with the same first name never get mixed up.
- **Rulesets.** Mail can't cross rulesets, so Postbox files your characters
  by ruleset (Normal, PvP, RP and RP-PvP) and warns before mail to one it
  has seen on another. It knows a character once you've logged in on it
  with Postbox, and never adds a realm to a Forever address.
- **Sending.** The Send tab warns about a first name alone, never suggests
  the Warband bank, and promises instant delivery between your characters
  only when the game does. A slow server isn't called a failure: if you
  close the mailbox while it waits, Postbox tells you to check your mailbox
  before sending again.
- **Gold from strangers.** The game asks before you take gold from someone
  it doesn't know, and Postbox waits for your answer. You answer the game's
  question; Postbox never answers it for you.
- **Reload and controller.** After a style change, **Reload now** reloads;
  in combat it asks you to type `/reload`. With the Gamepad interface style
  you get Blizzard's own mailbox, and a style change made with the mailbox
  open applies the next time you open it.
- **Known limit.** Postbox is built for Forever 1.60.1, so a Forever patch
  can show it as "out of date" until Postbox is updated.

## The Mail tab

![The Mail tab](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/egsherlock/Postbox/main/docs/screenshots/mail.png)

One inbox. Mail that still holds something comes first; read mail with nothing
left sits under a bar at the foot of the list: click it to fold it away, or
delete it all at once. While it is out of view the bar waits as a small
island over a soft shadow at the list's foot; scroll to it or click it and it
opens. How the bar looks (the **Island**, a thin **Hairline** or a **Full
row**), what it says (your own words too), its count, its icon and its colors
are yours to choose (**Bar look**, **Bar says**, **Count**, **Bar icon**,
**Bar color**, **Shadow color**). Read mail can go to a **Done** tab
instead, or be deleted the moment Postbox empties it (**Finished mail**,
**Where it goes**: **Delete when done**).

- **All mail** collects everything still holding something, one server
  command at a time, in the order the list shows. Under a search it collects
  what's shown; with rows selected (Shift-click a range, Ctrl-click one) it
  collects your picks. C.O.D. mail is never swept.
- **Sort and filter:** the button at the end of the search box sorts by
  date, time left, gold or sender (click again to reverse) and can show only
  unread mail, mail with gold or mail with items, several at once. Each
  filter shows as a chip under the button, with an x to let it go.
  **Remember sort order** (Options > Mail tab) keeps your order between
  visits; filters let go when the mailbox closes. Done keeps an order of
  its own; until you pick one it follows the Inbox. When your bags fill,
  what's left is the bottom of the list.
- **Time left** turns amber under three days (one for C.O.D.). On a mail that
  still holds something, a curved arrow in front says it goes back to its
  sender, a bin that it is deleted (**Expiry marks**, on the Time left card
  in Arrange, turns them off); the
  tooltip's **On expiry:** line says the same.
- **Largest stack first:** a mail holding several stacks of an item you can
  only carry so many of gives you the largest first.
- **Bags are checked before anything opens**, with an offer to collect what
  fits. **Keep bag slots free** (1 to 12) leaves room for loot; gold still
  comes out. If the bags fill anyway, the run stops and the title bar says
  how many mails are left. Nothing is collected behind your back.
- **Stuck** means one mail's own problem: a small triangle, the game's own
  words, and `Stuck: N` in the title bar, which filters the list to those
  mails. It clears itself once the mail can come out (for example once you
  hold fewer of a limited item). A slow reply just gets one more try.
- **Gold from strangers:** where the game asks before you take gold from
  someone it doesn't know (WoW Forever, and retail from patch 12.1.7), the
  run pauses on that mail until you answer: Accept and the gold comes,
  Cancel and it stays in the mail while the rest carries on.
- **C.O.D. prices are red,** as spent gold is, so amber only ever means time
  running out; the totals under the list add the C.O.D. still to pay.
- **Category buttons** (on by default; **Show category buttons**): All
  bought, All sold and All expired, with All canceled, Other and From alts
  one right-click away in Arrange, and one for each **Character Group** you
  make: your bank alts, your crafters, a friend who sends you materials.
- **Rows:** compact by default, or **Larger mail rows** on two lines. **Row
  layout** is Columns (every figure under its heading) or Packed (each mail's
  figures together, the subject gets the rest). Columns: read mark, item
  icon, sender, subject, time left ("9h", "3d"), gold, slots.
- **Item icons** carry stack counts and crafting quality marks, as your bags
  do. Hover an icon and its items fan out: click one to take it (C.O.D.
  still asks first), or set **Attachments on hover** to **Tooltip** for a
  list of what the mail holds.
- **Senders wear their class color** when Postbox knows them (your alts,
  friends, guild), in your UI's own class colors.
- **A sold auction wears the item that sold** in the Inbox, History and
  Mail Memory, where Postbox can tell which it was; **AH Sold icon** on the
  Item icon's card in Arrange brings back the gold coin.
- **One tooltip format everywhere:** the subject, then only what the row
  doesn't already show, and last what you can click, one gesture per line
  in smaller type.

  ![A search for ore taking just those mails, All mail taking the rest, then History showing what came in and what you sent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/egsherlock/Postbox/main/docs/screenshots/collect.gif)

  ![Scrolling down to the island at the list's foot: it opens into the bar over the read mail, and Delete all turns red under the pointer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/egsherlock/Postbox/main/docs/screenshots/finished.gif)

  ![Pointing at a short mail's bin: its tooltip says On expiry: deleted. Then at a player's mail's arrow: On expiry: returns to Kaelyth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/egsherlock/Postbox/main/docs/screenshots/expiry.gif)

  ![A Character Group and its button among the category buttons](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/egsherlock/Postbox/main/docs/screenshots/groups.png)

### History

![History searched across every character](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/egsherlock/Postbox/main/docs/screenshots/history.png)

The clock beside Inbox lists what Postbox collected on this character, newest
first: when, from whom, what came out and what it was worth, with the
letter's text kept after the mail is gone. **Received** and **Sent** switch
between that and the mail you sent: who each went to, exactly as you
addressed it, what it carried, its gold and any C.O.D. After a send, the line
above Send mail says who it went to (click it, or the clock at the left of
Send mail, to open Sent). Pick another character to see their History and Sent.
**Keep History for** 7 days up to a year, or **Never** (asks, then clears
every character's). **History holds** 1,000, 2,500 or 5,000 mails of each
per character (Options > General > Memory and history). History has its own
layout, shows when you collected ("3d ago" or the date, either way), and
**Search every character** looks through all of them.

Every search, here, on the Mail tab and in Mail Memory, finds a mail by its
sender or recipient, its subject, or any item attached to it.

## Arrange it your way

  ![Arranging the Mail tab](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/egsherlock/Postbox/main/docs/screenshots/arrange.png)

Click the arrange mark beside the options cog (Mail Memory's window has both
too):

- **A column header takes the top row's place**, each heading over its column.
  Drag a column by its heading or straight from any row; right-click to hide
  it, click it for its card, which holds that column's own settings: what
  Gold, Time left and Slots show (gold **Written as** letters or coins),
  stack counts and quality marks, expiry marks, and on the Item icon's card
  **Attachments on hover** and **AH Sold icon**.
- **The blocks under the list lift off:** the totals, All mail and the
  category buttons. Drag them into your order, move or hide single buttons,
  or hide the totals and buttons altogether.
- **A panel docks beside the window** and explains whatever you select.
  Escape steps back one thing at a time; **Done** finishes, and **Reset
  arrangement** goes back to the default after asking.

One-line rows (shared with Mail Memory), Larger mail rows and History each
keep their own arrangement. **Test mail** fills the list with sample mail
while you arrange, or on its own from the **Test mail** switch over the
Preview in the options, which reads **Testing** while it is on. The samples show what your
settings do: under **Delete when done** there is no read mail and no
bar, and resting on an item icon lists its items or fans them out, as
**Attachments on hover** is set, though nothing can be taken. **Arrange**
works away from a mailbox too, opening the window beside the options.

## Mail Memory

  ![Mail Memory searching every character](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/egsherlock/Postbox/main/docs/screenshots/mailmemory.png)

A snapshot of each character's mailbox, taken at every visit (up to 100
mails). Away from a mailbox it opens from the minimap icon, the addon
compartment or `/postbox mail`; at a mailbox, click **Inbox** (it wears
your class icon) to open the character list and show any character's box
right in the Mail tab (right-click it to come back to your own). **Search
every character** looks through all of them at once. Every box says how
long ago it was seen; it never pretends to be live. Mail you sent or
returned to one of your characters since then is listed on top, so you
know what is waiting there. Hover a mail to see what it holds. A character you no longer play can be hidden (right-click
it in the list, or tick it under Options > General > Characters > **Hidden
characters**), and **Character order** above it sets the list's order:
Warnings first (while Warn about expiring mail is on), Expiring soonest,
Most mail, Name or Last played.

- **Arrivals are detected, not guessed:** the game's new-mail signal, the
  unread flag, and the auction house's own sold / expired / bought notices.
- **Warnings** name any character with mail holding gold or items (or a
  C.O.D.) under three days (one for C.O.D.) from expiring, or with mail
  known to be on its way and no mailbox visit in over three weeks, the
  character you're on included. One choice, **Warn about expiring mail** (Options >
  General), sets what both warnings cover: **Deleted**,
  **Deleted or sent back**, or **Off** (mail last seen
  before 1.60 counts as possibly deleted, to be safe). They come as a
  line in chat at login (**Chat line at login**) and as the minimap icon's
  marker (**Minimap marker**: with the icon, always, or off); the minimap
  tooltip names them too.
- **Mail waiting in your mailboxes,** a card across the top of the options'
  General tab, lists each character's box as it was last seen (mail, gold,
  the soonest to expire with its arrow or bin, and how long ago), with a
  total for all of them. Mail about to go back or be deleted comes first,
  even on an alt you haven't played in months, then the characters you
  played most recently. Past three lines the list scrolls inside the card;
  past twenty characters it ends in "+N more in Mail Memory". Click a
  character to open its box in Mail Memory. Beside the list, Mail Memory,
  Character Groups and Manage Recipients are a click away. Under it, **The
  last 7 days**: gold earned and spent by mail, and mails collected and
  sent, for all characters or this one. With nothing waiting anywhere, the
  card says **Nothing waiting**.

## Sending

![The Send tab: a name completing, more than twelve items queued](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/egsherlock/Postbox/main/docs/screenshots/send.png)

- **Names complete in place** from your favorites, recent contacts, alts,
  guild, friends (Battle.net included) and players you grouped with
  recently; **Options > Send tab** chooses which sources are offered. Tab
  and Shift+Tab walk the suggestions, Enter takes the whole name, and the
  realm is added only when it's another realm. Right-click a suggestion to
  hide it; the star at its end favorites it.
- **Pin a name** with the small pin in the Recipient box and that
  character starts every mailbox with it: a miner that always mails your
  banker. Click the pin again to unpin; your other characters are left
  alone. **Recipient pin** (Options > Send tab) turns the pin off.
- **A guidance line** says whether the mail arrives instantly or in about an
  hour, and whether a cross-realm send can carry what's attached. It advises;
  it never blocks.
- **Past twelve items**, right-clicks keep queuing; one press sends the rest
  as further mails to the same person, after one confirmation. Alt+right-click
  attaches every stack of an item; right-click "Attachments" clears them all.
- **Gold asks first**, and asks again if the name, the amount, C.O.D. or the
  number of mails changes before you answer.
- **Ctrl+Enter sends** from any box (a setting, on by default; the Send button
  shows the keys). **After sending, keep** nothing, the recipient, or the
  recipient and subject.
- Shift-click an attached item to link it, Ctrl-click to try it on.
- Unmailable items in your bags are grayed with a padlock while you compose,
  in the default bags, Baganator and EllesmereUI bags.

**Manage Recipients** (`/postbox recipients`, works anywhere) is a table,
one line per name (Category, Class, Level, Played, Mailed, Note):
double-click a name to favorite it (or click its star), right-click to hide
it, click its note to write one, Shift- or Ctrl-click to select several, and
favorite, hide or delete them together. Category names every list a name is
in, and deleting a name your guild, friends or recently grouped list
still offers hides it too, since Postbox can't take anyone off those
lists.

  ![Manage Recipients: favorites, notes, hidden names and class colors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/egsherlock/Postbox/main/docs/screenshots/recipients.png)

## The minimap icon

  ![The minimap icon, its markers and tooltip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/egsherlock/Postbox/main/docs/screenshots/minimap.png)

Optional, and off until you turn it on; while it's on, the game's own mail
icon steps aside.

- **When to show:** New since last visit (mail that came since you last
  opened this character's mailbox; it needs Remember mailboxes), New mail,
  Mail on any character, or Always (resting in gray until something
  arrives).
- **Expiring mail:** a small marker, red unless you pick another color, when
  mail on any character is about to be deleted or sent back. **Minimap
  marker** (Options > Minimap > Expiring mail marker) switches it on, and
  **Warn about expiring mail** (Options > General) says which mail counts.
  Choose its shape (dot, ring,
  square, bar, "!" or a triangle that fits its spot), put it on any corner,
  side or the center of the icon, and nudge it a pixel at a time with
  **Offset X** and **Offset Y**. On **Always** it stays on the map while the
  icon is hidden, the same size and in the same place; **Larger when alone**
  makes it bigger there.
- **Count on icon** (this character or all), shadow, glow and pulse, with a
  **Glow color** of gold, your accent, your class color, white or any color
  you pick. **Flash on new mail** (Options > General) swells a
  halo in that color when mail arrives.
- **The Minimap tab** reads in four groups (When it shows, with Position and
  Lock position, Icon, Glow, Expiring mail marker). Its preview draws the icon large beside a copy at
  its real size, wearing every setting; settings with choices show them
  side by side, and a grayed-out setting says what turns it on. What needs
  Mail Memory (Mail on any character, Count on icon, the marker) is grayed
  out while it is off, and the marker's look also while Warn about expiring mail is Off.
- Two dozen hand-painted styles from 16 to 40 px, on the minimap's rim or
  anywhere on screen (Shift-drag; Alt-click locks it).
- **Its tooltip** shows your own mailbox first, then each of your other
  characters with mail. Click for Mail Memory, right-click for the options.
- Under EllesmereUI's minimap it restyles *their* mail button in place, and
  EllesmereUI keeps its size, place and its own Hide Mail setting.

## Options and looks

  ![The options](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/egsherlock/Postbox/main/docs/screenshots/options.png)

Five tabs (General, Window, Mail tab, Send tab, Minimap), one column
of settings, a search in the title bar that finds any setting and takes you
to it, and a panel beside it that explains whatever you point at and shows
it. **General** comes first: every character's mail and your last 7 days on
cards across the top, with **Mail Memory**, **Character Groups** and
**Manage Recipients** beside them; under them **Memory and history**
(Remember mailboxes, Keep History for, History holds), **Alerts** (Warn
about expiring mail, **Sound on new mail**, Minimap marker, whose button
opens the Minimap tab at the marker, Chat line at login and Flash on new
mail)
and **Characters** (Class icons, Character order, Hidden characters). The
sound is one of nine soft sounds made for Postbox, the mail chime or
another quiet sound of the game's, or any sound your other addons share
through LibSharedMedia, such as ElvUI's or a SharedMedia pack's, or
EllesmereUI's own alert sounds while it is loaded (with a button to hear
it first; it stays quiet for your own auction house purchases, which the
game already announces). The options open beside
whatever opened them: right of the Postbox
window from its cog, below Mail Memory from its cog (on General), left of the minimap
from the icon. With **Dock beside game windows** on they stay beside that
window as it moves or resizes, so you can watch a setting reshape it; drag
them and they stay where you put them. **Reset to defaults** opens a menu below it: **Reset this tab**, **Reset
settings** (your recipients, groups, Mail Memory and History are kept) or
**Reset everything**, each saying what it clears before it asks. **What's
new?** in the footer shows the last three releases. It never opens by
itself: after an update a dot on the options cog says there is news until
you open the options, and one on What's new? stays until you read it.

  ![Postbox under EllesmereUI, ElvUI, Blizzard and its own style](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/egsherlock/Postbox/main/docs/screenshots/looks.png)

- **EllesmereUI:** its font for all of Postbox's text, its accent, and **Match
  EllesmereUI** opacity and border (the default), so Postbox matches the
  windows beside it, atrocityEssentials' included. Under EllesmereUI's
  Blizzard Style or Classic WoW UI, or with EllesmereUI's skinning off for
  Postbox, Postbox wears its Blizzard look to match.
- **ElvUI:** its accent (value color) and class colors, live.
- **The Postbox style:** **Dark** or
  **Light** mode, accent (Gold by default, White and other presets, your
  class color or any color), background color, opacity, border (None, Edge,
  Thin or Thick) and its color, corners, row stripes, sheen, font (the
  game's, Barlow Semi Condensed, Expressway, Fira Sans Condensed, Noto Sans,
  Overpass or Roboto Condensed), text weight (Regular or Bold) and text size. In Light mode text is crisp dark ink and your accent stays in the
  marks; each mode keeps its own background.
- **Blizzard** (the default on the game's own UI), rebuilt from the game's
  own art: its window frame, red and dark buttons, tabs, boxes, dropdowns,
  checkboxes and scroll bars (bronze on WoW Forever), with your mail on the
  game's letter paper. Its own settings on the Window tab: **Row texture**
  (Light parchment, Dark parchment or None), **Buttons** (All red; Mail red,
  rest dark; All dark) and **Background opacity**, and its own Font, Text
  style and Text weight. Texture packs restyle it.
- **Class icons** (Options > General > Characters): how your characters'
  classes are drawn on the Inbox button and in its list: the game's own,
  Game (round), Painted, Pixel, Comic or Glyphs, EllesmereUI's sets while
  it is loaded, or None for no icon.
- **Window scale** from 80% to 130% in every look.

  ![The Postbox style in Dark and Light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/egsherlock/Postbox/main/docs/screenshots/lightdark.png)

## How it's built

- **No libraries.** `Lib/` is a small hand-rolled foundation: saved-variable
  store, event bus, string and money formatting, an inventory-lock overlay and
  a few UI primitives. No Ace, no LibStub.
- **It never replaces Blizzard's mail code.** Postbox draws its own window and
  calls the mail API directly; its arranging is its own, never Blizzard's Edit
  Mode. The one known combat case is documented in
  [COMBAT_TAINT.md](https://github.com/egsherlock/Postbox/blob/main/COMBAT_TAINT.md).
- **Idle means idle.** Nothing runs on a repeating timer away from a
  mailbox, and per-frame work runs only while you drag, resize or arrange
  something, stopping when you let go.
- **Measured, not assumed.** A 50-mail list refresh leaves under 2 KB of
  garbage (35 KB in 1.40), a collect run about a third of what it did, and a
  Mail/Send switch redraws your bags once instead of three times.
  `/postbox perf` records each mailbox visit for a bug report, with the game's
  own profiler split into Postbox, other addons and the game.
- **Safe by design.** One C.O.D. confirmation pays once, for the mail you
  chose; deleting in bulk only ever removes finished mail you chose, a mail
  that still holds something asks before it goes, and every delete is
  re-checked right before it happens; every take follows its mail as the
  inbox moves.
- **One skin contract.** A look claims the window at login and answers
  `Apply`/`Refresh`; see [ELLESMEREUI_SKINNING.md](https://github.com/egsherlock/Postbox/blob/main/ELLESMEREUI_SKINNING.md).

## Languages

English, Français, Deutsch, Español, Русский, 简体中文 and 繁體中文, complete
rather than partial, with plural rules per language (Russian's one/few/many
included). The Chinese translations began with **samuelbears**, and every
string since is kept complete. Corrections and new languages are welcome:
strings live in `Core/Locales.lua`.

## Install and commands

From CurseForge or any addon manager, or copy the `Postbox` folder into
`World of Warcraft\_retail_\Interface\AddOns\` (for WoW Forever,
`World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`). One download serves both
games. Settings are account-wide, and each game keeps its own. What changes
in WoW Forever is under [World of Warcraft: Forever](#world-of-warcraft-forever).

| Command | |
|---|---|
| `/postbox` or `/pb` | The options |
| `/postbox help` | The list of commands |
| `/postbox mail` | Mail Memory: every character's mailbox |
| `/postbox recipients` | Manage Recipients |
| `/postbox minimap` | Turn the minimap icon on or off |
| `/postbox whatsnew` | What's new in the last three releases |
| `/postbox perf` | Performance recording: off, on or detailed |
| `/postbox debug` | Report a bug: a copyable report (no character names, no full addon list) |

Licensed under [GPL v3](https://github.com/egsherlock/Postbox/blob/main/LICENSE). The fonts in `Media/Fonts/` and the Phosphor and Octicons icons in `Media/` carry their own licenses, in the files beside them. The Glyphs class icons in `Media/ClassIcons/` are by Lorc and Delapouite ([game-icons.net](https://game-icons.net/), CC BY 3.0), recolored.

releases.notes:
## 2.0.0

*Restart the game once after updating (a /reload is not enough).*

### New

- **The Blizzard look is rebuilt from the game's own art** and is the
  default on the game's own UI: the game's window frame, red and dark
  buttons, tabs, boxes and dropdowns, and your mail on the game's letter
  paper. If you never chose a Window style, this is the look you meet
  after updating; a style you chose is kept. Three settings of its own
  (Options > Window): Row texture (Light parchment, Dark parchment or
  None), Buttons (which buttons are red) and Background opacity. Prefer
  the Postbox style? Options > Window > Window style.
- **Sent mail:** History, the clock on the Mail tab, now has **Received**
  and **Sent**. Sent lists what you mailed, to whom, with its gold and any
  C.O.D. On the Send tab, the clock at the left of Send mail opens it
  while History is on.
- **Mail you send your own characters shows in their box:** on the Mail

## 1.60.0

**Postbox now runs in World of Warcraft: Forever as well as retail**, from
the same download: please report any bugs you find as an
[issue on GitHub](https://github.com/egsherlock/Postbox/issues) or a
CurseForge comment (**Report a bug**, at the foot of the options, gives you
a report to paste in). *Restart the game once after updating (a /reload is
not enough).*

### World of Warcraft: Forever

- **Full names:** Postbox uses Forever's first name and surname everywhere,
  in recipients, replies, Character Groups, Mail Memory and History, so two
  of your characters with the same first name never get mixed up. Type
  "Abla Stone" or "Abla-Stone".
- **Forever's mail rules:** Postbox files your characters by ruleset as you
  log in on them, and warns before mail to one on another ruleset or to a
  first name alone. It never suggests the Warband bank, and promises instant
  delivery only when the game does.
- **A slow send isn't called failed:** Postbox waits for the server, and if
  you close the mailbox meanwhile, tells you to check it before sending
  again.
- **Reload now works** after a style change (in combat, type /reload), and
  **controller players get Blizzard's mailbox** with the Gamepad interface
  style.
- Also: senders wear their class colors, From alts counts your alts' mail,
  EllesmereUI's WoW Forever look is matched, the options drawings show
  Forever's goods and the minimap icon's Blizzard style its mail art, and
  the quality-mark options are hidden, since vanilla goods have none.
  Forever keeps its own settings.

### Expiring mail

- **Expiring mail says where it goes:** when a mail still holding gold or
  items is down to its last three days (one for C.O.D.), a curved arrow
  before its amber time means it goes back to its sender, a bin that it
  will be deleted. Its tooltip and Mail Memory say so too; **Expiry marks**
  (Options, Mail tab) turns the marks off, and the tooltip still says.
- **One choice for both warnings:** **Warn about** (General, Expiring mail)
  sets what the login line and the minimap marker warn of: Mail to be
  deleted, Mail to be deleted or sent back (as before), or Off. Mail last
  seen before 1.60 counts as possibly deleted, to be safe. **Minimap
  marker** moved there from the Minimap tab, and your choices carry over.
- **The warnings agree:** the marker, its tooltip and the login line name
  every character you haven't hidden, the one you're on included, and only
  for mail holding gold or items (or a C.O.D.).

### The bar over finished mail

- **Quieter, and out of the way:** a little shorter than a row, on the
  list's own background, its words centered ("Done (3)"). While that mail
  is below the view, the bar waits at the list's foot as a small island
  over a soft shadow; scroll down or click it and it opens. Delete all turns
  red when you point at it, and takes a click only once the bar is open.
- **Make it yours** under Options, Mail tab, in a new **Finished mail**
  group: **Bar look** (Island, Hairline or Full row), **Bar says** (Done,
  Nothing left, Collected or your own words), **Count**, **Bar icon**,
  **Bar color** and **Shadow color**. **Where it goes** there is the choice
  1.50 called Read mail.

### At the mailbox

- **Gold from strangers waits for your answer.** Where the game asks before
  you take gold from someone it doesn't know (in Forever, and on retail from
  patch 12.1.7), collecting pauses on that mail: Accept and the gold comes,
  Cancel and it stays while the rest carries on. Postbox never answers for
  you.
- **A C.O.D. price is red,** as spent gold is, so amber means only time
  running out; the totals band adds the C.O.D. still to pay.
- **Tooltips end with one gesture per line,** in smaller type, so
  "Right-click to..." and "Shift-click to..." no longer run together.

### Options

- **A General tab comes first:** every character's mail as its box was last
  seen, with a total, and mail about to go back or be deleted first, even
  on an alt you haven't played in months. Click a character to open its box
  in Mail Memory. Mail Memory's settings live here now, with Expiring mail
  and New mail.
- **Choose the sound for new mail:** four soft sounds made for Postbox, the
  mail chime, four of the game's, or any your other addons share, such as
  ElvUI's or WeakAuras', with a button to hear it first. It stays quiet for
  your own auction house purchases, which the game already announces. If
  you had the sound on, it stays the mail chime.
- **Try your settings on sample mail:** **Test**, beside Arrange under
  Options, Mail tab, works at a mailbox or anywhere else, and nothing in it
  can be collected.
- **Windows open beside what opened them,** and with Dock beside game
  windows on, the options follow the Postbox window as it moves or resizes.
  Mail Memory has the options cog too.
- **The options say each thing once:** no tooltip repeating the panel's
  description, and a grayed-out setting says what turns it on.
- **What's new opens by itself, once,** beside the mail window the first
  time you open a mailbox with 1.60 (never in combat), to say Postbox now
  supports WoW Forever. **What's new?**, at the foot of the options, opens
  it any time.
- Also: Reset to defaults opens downward; arranging from the options leaves
  them open; /postbox debug's report says which game it runs in, still
  without naming anyone; Battle.net friends are suggested only from a game
  Blizzard can deliver mail to; Keep bag slots free's first choice reads
  Never; a button's words no longer grow when you point at it; the quality
  mark on Larger mail rows is a touch smaller.

### Fixed

- When the game asks you to confirm sending gold or items to someone it
  doesn't know, the Send tab waits for your answer, and Cancel keeps your
  draft.
- Sending more than 12 items in one press sends every mail in full, and
  Send waits while the game asks about a refundable item you are attaching.
- Delete when done deletes every letter you empty, however quickly it

- A new C.O.D. mail no longer sets off the expiry warnings: they count it

- Reset this tab on the Minimap tab also forgets where you dragged the
  icon.

## 1.40.0

**The biggest Postbox update yet.** Every character's mailbox in one place, a
History of everything you collect, and a tidier inbox.
*After updating, restart the game once (a /reload is not enough) so Postbox
shows up in the minimap's addon menu.*

### New

- **Every character's mailbox, in one place.** Mail Memory remembers what each
  of your characters has waiting. Check any of them from the minimap icon,
  wherever you are, or right in the Mail tab when you are at a mailbox, and
  search all of them at once.
- **History.** The clock beside Inbox lists everything Postbox collected: when,
  from whom, what it was worth, and what each letter said. It keeps a week, or
  up to a month if you like.
- **Warnings before mail is lost.** Postbox tells you when mail on another
  character is about to expire, or has been waiting on a character you have
  not played in weeks.
- **See new mail before you reach a mailbox.** Auctions that sell, expire or
  are bought while you are away show up in Mail Memory by item name.
- **From alts.** A new button collects everything your own characters sent
  you, on any realm.
- **Alt+right-click attaches every stack** of an item at once; whatever does
  not fit waits in the queue.
- **Postbox speaks Traditional Chinese (繁體中文),** translated by samuelbears,
  who also brought us Simplified Chinese. Thank you! If a word reads oddly,
  please say so on GitHub.

### Improved

- **One tidy inbox.** Mail still to collect comes first. Read mail with
  nothing left in it folds away under a divider that deletes it in one click.
  Rather have it elsewhere? Options can give it a tab of its own, or delete it
  for you as you go (History keeps what it said).
- **Compact rows by default,** lined up in neat columns. You choose what each
  row shows (gold, slots, time left) and in what order; "Larger mail rows"
  brings the two-line rows back.
- **Clearer counts.** Inbox counts everything in the box, each button counts
  what it would collect, and a button with nothing to do is greyed out.
- **Crafted items and reagents show their quality mark** on the icon.
- **Handy shortcuts:** click "Stuck" in the title bar to see only the mail the
  game would not hand over, right-click "Attachments" to empty a mail you are
  writing, and clear a search with one click. "AH Bought" is back, and its
  button now leads the row.
- **Faster** on big mailboxes and long histories, and the options fit on
  screen again.
- Also: names without the realm, searching "sold" or "AH" finds auction mail,
  Mail Memory can list what expires first and be made wider, the resize grips
  explain themselves, and the new-mail sound and flash work with Mail Memory
  switched off.

### Fixed

- The minimap icon's tooltip could say "Nothing waiting" on a character whose
  mail had arrived while it was logged out.
- "Stuck" warnings could appear on mail that was never refused.
- Buying from the auction house played the new-mail alert twice.
- The Postbox Modern look could interfere with other addons' tooltips.
- Mail Memory lost track past 50 mails, and one of its tooltips could cause an
  error.
